answer: Bindings are kept in lotus, verified in falcon, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, and as a result it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the walnut check. A 135 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
